claim: Patchline ships an energy-and-carbon accounting report for every large analysis run. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the carbon claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make energy-carbon-accounting-gate`.
